cli.policy.grants.header: {count} standing approval(s) of yours (id · tool · kind · pattern):
cli.policy.grants.none: You have no persisted standing approvals in this scope.
cli.policy.revoke.reason: Revoked by the operator with `deckent policy revoke`.
cli.policy.upgrade.reason: Add the missing current first-run policy rules
cli.policy.upgrade.preview: The first-run policy (revision {revision}) can take the missing first-run rules; nothing was written. Apply: deckent policy upgrade --template current --scope {scope} --apply --expect {revision}
cli.policy.upgrade.wouldRefuse: Applying it would be refused: you lack
cli.policy.upgrade.upgraded: The first-run rules were added through the governed policy change (audited; the previous documents are archived). Undo: deckent policy upgrade --template current --scope {scope} --rollback
cli.policy.upgrade.current: This policy already has the current first-run rules; nothing to do.
cli.policy.upgrade.missing.approvalDecid: - the right to decide approvals (the change asks on its own card)
cli.policy.upgrade.missing.delegation: - the authority these rules give (you may grant only what you hold)
cli.policy.upgrade.missing.lockout: - a way back: without these rules you could no longer change policy or decide approvals (rollback refused)
cli.policy.upgrade.unavailable: This policy is not a first-run policy ({reason}); add the current first-run rules with your own policy authority.
cli.policy.upgrade.conflict: The policy changed since the preview (now revision {revision}); preview again.
cli.policy.upgrade.rolledBack: The first-run rules were removed ({ids}); the earlier documents stay archived.
cli.policy.upgrade.nothing: No first-run rule to remove; nothing was written.
cli.policy.revoke.notFound: No standing approval {id} of yours in this scope; nothing changed.
cli.policy.revoke.done: Standing approval {id} revoked; the same call asks again.
cli.policy.revoke.kept: Standing approval {id} kept (not confirmed; pass --yes to confirm without a terminal).
decision.noAdvice: No advice is available for this state.
decision.authorityNotice: Selection grants no authority. The next operation re-enters principal, scope, policy and approval checks.
decision.replayed: Existing record returned; no automatic paid retry.
decision.prepared: Case prepared: {digest}. Policy thresholds: choice {choice}, sufficiency {sufficiency}.
cli.policy.upgrade.deprecated:
The v5 selector is deprecated; it uses the current first-run template.
Use deckent policy upgrade --template current --scope {scope} --preview.
